fusions.name: Spray Off
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off the shield as 4 droplets at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage and leaving what it hits [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Skip Across
fusions.desc: Skims the shield low across the ground, dealing 11 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. It knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You regain 6 health.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. You have 10% water resistance.
